speakers.name: Christoph Lassner
speakers.org: World Labs (co-founder; no longer holds an active role, speaking in a personal capacity)
speakers.background: Background at the intersection of machine learning, computer vision and computer graphics; prior academic work on 3D reconstruction and rendering, including reconstructing physical properties (hair, plush materials) for simulation. Co-founded World Labs in early 2024 with Fei-Fei Li, Justin Johnson and Ben Mildenhall; World Labs' first public model/product is Marble. Stepped back after an e-scooter accident earlier this year; this is his first public talk since recovery.
